handoffs.message: PINT-001 implemented and PR opened: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/3412 (task/PINT-001 -> dev, auto-merge enabled). Freezes services/control-plane/specs/agora/v7/persona_opinion_consultation_event.schema.json + governed_action_authority_request.schema.json, capability_manifest_v1_6.json, bundle_index.v1_6.json, and docs/product/persona-interaction-and-governed-action-plan.md. Contract freeze only, no backend routes. Please review the authority-boundary proof in section 5 of the plan doc against PERSONA_RUNTIME_MODEL.md and the two control-plane decision docs.

Changes required: both schemas use nullableString/nullableDateTime in fields whose mere presence is claimed as proof. A persona_session with session_id:null validates, violating PERSONA_RUNTIME_MODEL.md section 13 mediation; a resolved authorized authority request with decision_by:null and resolved_at:null also validates, contradicting section 5's auditable governance-owner proof. Make conditional session_id non-null for persona_session actors and resolved decision_by/resolved_at non-null, then add negative validation cases and refresh bundle digests.

Fixed the null-loophole: sessionActorRef's persona_session branch now overrides session_id to a non-null string in its then-clause (PERSONA_RUNTIME_MODEL.md section 13), and GovernedActionAuthorityRequest's resolved-status branch now overrides decision_by/resolved_at to non-null (section 5). Added scripts/test_agora_v1_6_bundle.py (13 cases covering both null-loophole negatives plus positive/other-status acceptance) and refreshed bundle_index.v1_6.json digests for both schema files. Also merged origin/dev into task/PINT-001 to resolve an add/add path conflict on docs/product/persona-interaction-and-governed-action-plan.md against the newly-merged PINT-PLAN-001 baseline (kept dev's canonical planning doc; our contract-trace narrative remains in the commit history). PR #3412 merged into dev at 7d8bffeaa. python3 -m pytest scripts/test_agora_v1_6_bundle.py -q: 13 passed.

APPROVED: PR #3412 merged to dev at 7d8bffeaab9761cc2b34919aeb9b5c53f297208a; 13 Agora v1.6 contract tests passed; bundle digests, session mediation, resolved-decision proof, and no-capital/no-command boundaries verified.
